text:
jordan: Deploy bot stopped a promote for redwood/service-api:2026.03.21-canary because GCR returned attestation.replay detected on mirrored manifest. It suggested a hold. Anyone on releases awake?

deploy-bot: [automation] promote blocked: attestation.replay_detected
```
ACTION: promote blocked
reason: attestation.replay_detected on mirror-gcr-eu
image: redwood/service-api:2026.03.21-canary
digest: sha256:deadbeefcafebab1
suggested_action: hold_and-manual-verify
```
maya: Ugh. This is different from ttl-missing. Replay means a mirrored attestation with an older timestamp exists. Could be mirror re-sync after KMS key rotation.

patrick: If mirror re-synced with stale attestation the digest could still be correct, but we can't accept replay without manual check. Releasing tonight at 21:30UTC. We need either a manual verification step and pin the digest or abort and repush.

devrel: For canary we can allow manual verify + pin if we record the reasoning in release notes and file an incident ticket. We try to avoid repush during a change window unless necessary.

oncall-lee: Rollback criteria? If we allow the manual proceed and the canary shows increased error rates, we need a fast path. Our promote tool can revert tag-to-digest to previous digest within seconds. We should capture previous digest now.

jordan: Current previous pinned digest from artifacts-db is sha256:c0ffee1234567890. I'll grab it and put in the ticket.

maya: Also note: the GCR mirror had a KMS key rotation last night (ops-changes). Mirror proxy logs show a reingest job around 02:14Z that could cause attest timestamp variance. We should confirm no layer corruption.

patrick: Proposal: hold publish and run quick verification: 1) verify manifest content equality between primary registry and gcr mirror; 2) validate cosign sigs against current key; 3) if only attestation timestamp differs but manifest/digest identical, allow manual promote with digest pin and add release-note and INF ticket.

devrel: I support that. We must ensure release notes include manifest digest and link to INF-2001. Also ensure automated release notes generator doesn't collapse tag->digest mapping when it sees a retag.

oncall-lee: I'll add a pre-promote check to the pipeline that compares manifest digests and fails if layers mismatch. That gives us safety.

jordan: Doing quick manifest compare now: primary digest sha256:deadbeefcafebab1, gcr mirror digest sha256:deadbeefcafebab1, layers match. Cosign signature validates against current key id KMS-01. Looks like replay-only difference in attestation timestamp.

patrick: Given that, I'm OK with manual promote with pin. Rules: must create INF-2001, must include the pinned digest in the release note, must mark the release as "manual-pin due to attestation replay". Also add a rollback plan: revert to sha256:c0ffee1234567890 if canary >2x error or latency within 10m.

devrel: Command to run (use this exact one):
```
/deploybot promote --image redwood/service-api:2026.03.21-canary \
  --pin-digest sha256:deadbeefcafebab1 \
  --reason "attestation.replay on gcr mirror; manifest equality verified" \
  --change-window 2026-03-21T21:30Z
```

deploy-bot: [automation] manual override requested by jordan. Waiting for explicit `/deploybot promote` command.

jordan: Created INF-2001: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2001 - title: "gcr mirror attestation replay: validate mirror behavior and tighten promote guards" - assigned to @maya.

oncall-lee: Added pipeline guard: pre-promote manifest-diff check and immediate rollback hook. Also saved previous digest sha256:c0ffee1234567890 in rollback metadata.

jordan: Running `/deploybot promote` now with pin.

deploy-bot: [automation] promote accepted. Job id: promote-8814. Pinned digest: sha256:deadbeefcafebab1. Canary started.

patrick: I'll monitor canary metrics and be ready to revert. Whoever is on-call, please watch the alerts channel.

maya: Filing follow-up runbook item to add a mirror attestation timestamp tolerance check and to document KMS rotation impact. Will update INF-2001 with notes.

jordan: Adding release note snippet: "canary published with manual digest pin due to GCR attestation replay; digest sha256:deadbeefcafebab1; follow-up INF-2001."

oncall-lee: Closing loop: if canary breaches rollback thresholds, automated rollback will promote sha256:c0ffee1234567890 and post a status update in #incidents.

jordan: Thanks all. Will close this thread after canary completes successfully.
